requests.result: Current official viewer HTML retrieved; UI documents 일필지정보 (single-parcel information), land layers, and the non-legal-reference nature of the map.
Current viewer map configuration retrieved; EPSG:5179 is configured and the viewer uses public map WFS/WMS/WMTS routes through map.kgeop.go.kr:20000/bag.
DNS resolution failed from this host; no capabilities or feature response obtained. This is a route/network failure, not evidence of cadastral absence.
Official Government24 page documents cadastral-map/forest-map certificate viewing and issuance; no protected personal or title data requested.
Official Cheonan city land-statistics page retrieved; it confirms city land administration/statistics but is not a parcel geometry service.
Official land-use viewer response demonstrates Korean parcel/PNU-oriented land information, but the example parcel is outside the exact WUP point and no geometry was retained or inferred.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official national K-GeoP parcel-information viewer, Government24 cadastral-map procedure, and Cheonan city official land-information pages reviewed.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Viewer existence, current JavaScript/configuration, EPSG:5179, and public map route declarations were verified; anonymous cadastral feature retrieval was not verified because the declared map host was unreachable from this host.

technicalBlocker: The viewer's declared map.kgeop.go.kr WFS route failed DNS resolution; no feature schema, safe ID, or polygon was returned.
remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point may lie within cadastral coverage. Viewer route failure and lack of an exact-point feature response are not evidence of citywide absence.
nextStep: Serial reviewer may independently qualify the current K-GeoP map WFS/WMS route from a network that resolves map.kgeop.go.kr; keep runtime readiness held until a real safe geometry adapter is independently qualified.
pointBasis: Exact unchanged WUP 2025 settlement point (latitude, longitude); not shifted to force a parcel hit.
